title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Everything you need to know about Quantix, Harees, and Qiasat.

questions.a: Quantix is an intelligent Salla store management platform comprising two specialized apps: Harees (batch-by-batch expiry date monitoring) and Qiasat (smart measurement calculator for area and quantity). Together they help Salla merchants reduce waste, increase sales, and streamline operations.

Quantix offers a free tier with basic features. Premium plans unlock advanced functionality such as automated discounting, batch tracking, and priority support. Visit our pricing page or contact support@quantixapp.dev for detailed plan comparison.

questions.q: Which Salla plan do I need?
questions.a: Quantix works with any active Salla store. Some advanced features (like bulk product syncing) may require a Salla paid plan. Check Salla's documentation for compatibility details.

questions.q: Do I need technical knowledge to use Quantix?
questions.a: No. Both Harees and Qiasat are designed for non-technical users. Installation takes just a few clicks through Salla's App Market, and the dashboard guides you through setup step by step.

questions.q: How does Harees track product expiry dates?
questions.a: Harees connects to your Salla store and lets you add batch-by-batch expiry records for each product. It automatically flags items approaching their expiry date and sends notifications so you can take action before products expire.

questions.q: How does the Harees discount workflow work?
questions.a: When a product is nearing its expiry date, Harees allows you to apply an automatic discount to accelerate its sale. The flow is: (1) Harees detects an expiring batch and prompts you to set a discount percentage and price; (2) You configure the discount in the Harees dashboard (percentage off, discounted price, and optional minimum quantity); (3) Harees applies the discount to the specific batch variant in Salla via the Salla API; (4) When the batch sells or is removed, Harees automatically cancels the discount in Salla so regular pricing is restored — no manual cleanup required. You can review active discounts at any time from the dashboard and cancel them early if needed.

questions.q: What happens when a product expires?
questions.a: Harees marks expired batches in red on your dashboard. You can hide or remove expired batches from active inventory. Harees does not automatically delete products — you retain full control over what to do with expired stock.

questions.q: Does Harees support multiple batches for the same product?
questions.a: Yes. You can add multiple batches with different expiry dates, quantities, and purchase prices for the same product. This is especially useful for products with staggered delivery or production runs.

Qiasat embeds a smart measurement calculator directly into your Salla product pages. Customers can enter dimensions or quantities and get instant, accurate calculations — eliminating guesswork and reducing returns due to incorrect sizing.

questions.q: Can I customize the calculation rules?
questions.a: Absolutely. Qiasat gives you full control over calculation formulas. You can set area-based pricing, quantity multipliers, waste factors, and dimension limits per product. Changes take effect immediately on your storefront.

questions.q: Which types of products work with Qiasat?
questions.a: Qiasat is ideal for products sold by area (flooring, tiles, wallpaper), volume (concrete, gravel, liquids), or length (pipes, cables, fabrics). It works with any Salla product that has configurable options.

questions.q: How do I connect my Salla store?
questions.a: Click "Login with Salla" on the Harees or Qiasat login page. You'll be redirected to Salla's authorization screen. Grant the requested permissions, and you'll be returned to your Quantix dashboard — fully synced.

questions.q: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.a: We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard) and Salla Pay where available. All payments are processed securely through our payment partner.

questions.q: Is my Salla data safe with Quantix?
questions.a: Yes. Quantix uses industry-standard encryption (TLS 1.3) for all data in transit and AES-256 for data at rest. We never store your Salla password — authentication uses OAuth 2.0 tokens with scoped permissions. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

questions.q: Does Quantix share my data with third parties?
questions.a: No. Quantix never sells or shares your data with third parties. We use sub-processors only for essential infrastructure (hosting, monitoring) under strict data processing agreements.
